title: EA SPORTS FC 27
summary: The Steam copy only starts on a Mac with FC 27 Live Editor in it, a mod tool you download and provide: EA AntiCheat's launcher starts nothing here, and the game closed the moment the editor's window went in. This asks you for your Live Editor folder and copies it, gives the game, alone, the Windows function its activation asks for, loads a library that lets its Direct3D hooks work on D3DMetal and makes Steam's Play start the game with it. Offline, without EA AntiCheat or online modes. NotProton with CrossOver Preview 41303 (Rosetta) only. AT YOUR OWN RISK: MacGameFix does not answer for failures in the game, its saves, its mods or your account.

excerpts.note: Once kernel32.dll is mapped in the game's process, its export directory stays where it is and gets new arrays with one more name, in its sorted place; the function is a few instructions outside the directory, so Wine does not take it for a forward to another DLL.

A D3DMetal method is a 16-byte stub that jumps through the pointer behind it, which an inline hook copies wrong. The same 16 bytes become mov rax, method; jmp rax, which can be copied anywhere. Through mprotect and an ordinary store, so that Rosetta drops its translation of the old stub.

The stubs are looked for in the memory where Wine keeps DLLs, and only those whose pointer lands inside D3DMetal are taken. A page that has run shows as read-only to the kernel under Rosetta, so writable is not asked for.
Live Editor is the player's to provide: from MacGameFix's window the install asks for its folder with macOS's folder chooser, every time, which is also how a new version goes in.
Live Editor's launcher injects 100 ms after the game appears, and at that the game hung at "Injecting" in 2 starts of 10. Its own setting is raised to 1000 ms; a longer one the player set is kept.

Live Editor's launcher has to be waiting before the game starts; then Steam's own command, and the batch file stays until FC27.exe is gone, since NotProton closes the prefix when the program it started ends.

symptom: Steam's Play shows EA AntiCheat's launcher for some seconds and no game starts. With FC 27 Live Editor's launcher open the game starts, first with "There is a problem with your game's setup. Please reinstall your game", and once past that it closes right after the EA SPORTS logo, without a message.
cause: Three things. The game imports FindPackagesByPackageFamily from kernel32, which Wine 11.21 does not have. EA AntiCheat's launcher ends after 10 s with 0xE111000B under Wine; Live Editor's launcher puts a stand-in in its place, and with the stand-in alone the game ends 9 s in, so the game runs here only with Live Editor's DLL in it. And Live Editor draws its window by hooking Direct3D methods inline: D3DMetal's are 16-byte stubs, 66 90 / FF 25 00 00 00 00 / pointer, a jump through the pointer right behind it. The hook copies the first two instructions elsewhere, where the jump reads the copy's own next instruction as its target: an execute fault at 0x3C25FF (the bytes FF 25 3C 00 00 00 00 00) on the first ExecuteCommandLists after the hooks went in.
fix: MacGameFix's shared Engine fixes row has NotProton load mgf-engine.dylib, which arms in FC 27 alone a fix that adds the function, answering no packages as engine patch 0041 does, to the kernel32.dll Wine maps in the game's process, so the runner need not carry 0041 for every game. The install asks for the player's Live Editor folder and copies it, puts a script before %command% in Steam's launch options that opens Live Editor's launcher, starts Steam's own command and stays until the game is gone, and has the same engine library rewrite each D3DMetal stub in place to mov rax, method; jmp rax (1302 of them in FC 27's first 9 s). MacGameFix's shared rows Start through the mod tool and Play opens switch it and choose what Play opens (the game, the game with Wine's exception notes, or Live Editor's launcher window); nothing a player may set is typed into the launch options by hand. Played on 2026-11-23 with the steps done by hand: the game to its main menu with Live Editor's window on F9, 4 min 35 s, closed by the player. The editors themselves, a match and a long session were not played.
crossover: CrossOver Preview 27 (27.0.0.41303), NotProton runner on Rosetta, 2026-11-23
